verdict.rationale: Sentry's own OTLP concept docs say it ingests OpenTelemetry traces and logs through OTLP endpoints, either directly from an OTel SDK or via the OpenTelemetry Collector. That delivers the core of sending telemetry directly over OTLP. Missing for 10: evidence of OTLP metrics ingestion, deeper documentation of endpoint configuration and authentication, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the OTel support is first-class.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send telemetry directly over OTLP with first-class OpenTelemetry support

citations.quote: Sentry can ingest OpenTelemetry traces and logs via OTLP endpoints, either directly from an OTel SDK or through a pipeline tool like the OpenTelemetry Collector.
